chapters.7.meaning: The flood destroys life across the earth. Noah’s household survives inside the ark.
chapters.16.meaning: God hears Hagar when she has fled from harsh treatment. He speaks to her about her child.
chapters.22.meaning: Abraham prepares to offer Isaac. God stops him and provides a ram.
chapters.34.meaning: Shechem harms Dinah. Her brothers’ revenge kills the town’s men and takes its families captive.
chapters.47.lds: Joseph gives people food, but they lose land and freedom. How can help protect both?
people.hagar.meaning: Hagar names God as the one who sees her. God hears her distress.
places.sodom.summary: Lot lives in Sodom. Genesis 19 tells how the city is destroyed.
